evidence: decorative_mascot: For the first ~23s (hook@0.8, seg0:mid, seg1:start, seg2:start/mid) Data just stands arms-out in the middle of the bar track and slides sideways with no setup->action->payoff tied to any stat; only at seg3:end/seg4 does he ride the line down to 9.1.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start/seg2:mid - Data stands dead-centre over the 2000 and 2005 bars, covering their tips and value labels; at seg2:end the values 475.6 / 679.5 / 863.3 / 1016 / 1067 are rendered in dark grey inside the pink fills and are barely legible, and the headline claim 'nearly tripled' is never shown as a tripling - just five bars that get longer. The caption 'climbing? Health spending' also collides with the source line at the panel's bottom edge.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The mascot is anchored to the chart's centre rather than to a free margin, and the bar-race template reuses in-bar value labels with insufficient contrast; the scene plan gives the beat no comparative device for the 3x multiple.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Move Data out of the bar track (right margin / lower third, below the last bar) so no bar tip or value label is covered, raise value-label contrast to white-on-pink or place labels outside the bar ends, and stage the tripling explicitly - e.g. hold the 2000 bar as a ghost and stack three copies of it against the 2018 bar so $476 -> $1,317 is demonstrated, not just labelled.
